answer: Divergent Path Attestation. Each agent periodically signs a random challenge chaining its prior signed history; identical clones produce identical chains, so any fork is detectable. An honest agent's chain drifts like a gale across unique local entropy. A clone that must stay synchronized can never branch, so it cannot answer a challenge about a private island of state without exposing the split. Verification costs a sable sweep of chain hashes, while attackers pay one full independent history per identity.
